translations: Amazon 宣布，计划在 2025 年底前把同日达和次日达服务扩展到美国 4,000 多个小城市、城镇和乡村社区，覆盖数千万名客户。继 2023 和 2024 年为 Prime 会员创下快速配送纪录后，Amazon 表示会在 2025 年继续提升配送速度；截至公告时，2025 年美国同日达或次日达商品数量同比增加了 30% 以上。
公司计划投入超过 40 亿美元，到 2026 年底将配送网络规模扩大至三倍，重点覆盖小城镇和乡村地区。

fullTextParagraphs: More customers than ever before will soon be able to shop a wide range of popular items, including Amazon’s everyday essentials selection, for delivery within hours

SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) today announced plans to expand the convenience and reliability of Same-Day and Next-Day Delivery to tens of millions of U.S. customers in more than 4,000 smaller cities, towns, and rural communities by the end of the year. After delivering to Prime members at record-breaking speeds in 2023 and 2024, Amazon is continuing to innovate to deliver even faster in 2025. So far this year the number of items delivered the same or next day in the U.S. increased over 30% compared to the same period last year.Amazon expands Same-Day Delivery to rural communities across the U.S

This expansion goes beyond speed—it's about transforming daily life for rural customers, who typically live farther from brick-and-mortar retailers, have fewer product and brand choices, and face limited delivery options when shopping online. By investing in rural communities, Amazon’s speedy delivery will save customers time and money regardless of where they live—from North Padre Island, Texas and Asbury, Iowa to Lewes, Delaware and Fort Seneca, Ohio. With Prime, members have access to unlimited free Same-Day Delivery when spending over $25 at checkout.

“Everybody loves fast delivery. So, whether you live in Monmouth, Iowa or in downtown Los Angeles, now you're going to have the same fantastic Amazon customer experience: the ability to get the wide variety of items you need to keep your household running every day, delivered the same or next day,” said Doug Herrington, CEO of Worldwide Amazon Stores.

One of the biggest benefits of this expansion is the option for customers to shop Amazon’s everyday essentials, which encompasses a vast selection of affordable groceries and household goods. These items are speed-critical, and when customers need them, they often want them delivered as soon as possible. No one wants to wait two days to receive paper towels, diapers, or dog food when they’ve run out. This is why Amazon has started offering a large selection of everyday essentials for Same-Day Delivery, making it easier than ever for customers in small towns and rural communities to quickly stock up on groceries and household goods without needing to make an extra trip to the store. In the first quarter of 2025, Amazon’s fast delivery speeds helped drive its everyday essentials selection—comprising groceries and household essentials—to grow more than twice as fast as all other categories in the U.S. Amazon is one of the largest grocers in the U.S., with over $100B in gross sales—even when you exclude sales from Whole Foods Market and Amazon Fresh.

The response from customers in the more than 1,000 smaller cities, towns, and rural communities where Amazon has already begun offering free Same-Day and Next-Day Delivery has been very positive. As a result of the faster delivery speeds, customers in these areas are shopping Amazon’s store more frequently and purchasing household essentials at meaningfully higher rates. Of the top 50 repurchased items for Same-Day Delivery in these areas, over 90% are Amazon everyday essentials items.
Here’s how Amazon is continuing to innovate to deliver faster for customers living in small towns and rural communities:

Investing over $4 billion to triple the size of our delivery network by the end of 2026, with a focus on small towns and rural communities across the country, bringing faster delivery speeds and more jobs to these areas. For each new facility Amazon opens, an average of 170 jobs will be created at the delivery stations themselves, plus many more through driving opportunities with the DSP and Amazon Flex programs. For those in full-time roles, Amazon delivery stations provide an average hourly wage nearly triple the federal minimum and benefits like health care from day one of employment.

Transforming existing rural delivery stations into hybrid hubs that serve multiple functions. This includes storing inventory on site to enable delivery within hours and preparing packages for final delivery to customers. This innovative approach maximizes Amazon’s existing rural infrastructure to position products closer to customers’ doorsteps and reduce transportation distances.

Using advanced machine learning algorithms to predict which items will resonate with local Prime members based on their unique needs. This includes stocking a mix of the most-popular and frequently purchased items like wireless headphones, coffee pods, crackers, paper towels, and diapers, and products curated to fit local preferences like wild bird food in Dubuque, Iowa, travel backpacks in Findlay, Ohio, and after sun body butter in Sharptown, Maryland.

Customers can see whether their area has Same-Day Delivery by visiting amazon.com/samedaystore and browsing by category, price point, and retail store. Customers can also look for “free delivery today” next to product names while shopping across Amazon.

notes.phrase: by the end of the year
notes.explain: by + 时间点表示截止时间；公告里的计划日期不等于服务已经全部覆盖。
notes.example: The new service is expected to reach all branches by September.

notes.phrase: triple the size of our delivery network
notes.meaning: 把配送网络规模扩大至三倍
notes.explain: triple 是“变为三倍”，不是“增加三倍”；这里描述目标规模。
notes.example: We plan to triple the number of local pickup points.

notes.phrase: over 90% are Amazon everyday essentials items
notes.meaning: 超过 90% 是亚马逊日常必需品
notes.explain: over 90% 是比例；items 指前 50 个复购商品中的商品，不是所有订单。
notes.example: Over 70% of repeat purchases came from household essentials.

scenario.title: 虚构情境练习｜汇报新地区的当日补货服务
english: A grocery supplier plans to expand same-day restocking to 800 small towns by December.
It will convert 20 depots into local hubs and add frequently ordered household goods.
In the first 100 towns, repeat orders have increased, and most repeat purchases are basic supplies. Write a three-sentence update for regional operations.
chinese: 一家食品供应商计划在 12 月前把当日补货扩展到 800 个小城镇。
公司将把 20 个仓库改为本地枢纽，并增加常订购的家庭日用品。
在首批 100 个城镇，重复订单增加了，复购商品大多是日常用品。请给区域运营团队写三句话。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据 Amazon 于 2025 年 6 月 24 日发布的公告，给区域运营团队写三句话：说明当时计划扩展到哪里、配送网络有哪些调整，以及已覆盖地区出现了什么需求信号。
firstAttempt.sample: In its June 24, 2025 announcement, Amazon said it planned to expand Same-Day and Next-Day Delivery to more than 4,000 smaller U.S. communities by the end of 2025. The company said it would invest over $4 billion to triple its delivery network by the end of 2026 and turn some rural stations into hybrid hubs. In areas already served, Amazon reported that more than 90% of its 50 most-repurchased Same-Day Delivery items were everyday essentials.
firstAttempt.rationale: 将 2025 年 6 月公告中的服务扩张计划、网络投资计划和已覆盖地区的观察结果分开报告，并保留各自时间范围。

words.collocation: convert a station into a hybrid hub
words.example: The depot will become a hybrid hub for storage and dispatch.
words.translation: 这个仓库将转为兼具储存和派送功能的枢纽。

words.example: The team will store fast-moving inventory closer to customers.
words.translation: 团队会把周转快的商品存放在离客户更近的地点。

words.example: Most repurchased items were daily essentials.
words.translation: 复购最多的商品大多是日常必需品。

taskPhrases.word: expand the service to new areas
taskPhrases.example: We plan to expand delivery to 20 more communities.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们计划把配送扩展到另外 20 个社区。

taskPhrases.word: by the end of the year
taskPhrases.collocation: complete the rollout by a deadline
taskPhrases.example: We expect to reach 800 towns by the end of the year.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们预计在年底前覆盖 800 个城镇。

taskPhrases.word: as a result of faster delivery
taskPhrases.collocation: customer behavior changed as a result of a service improvement
taskPhrases.example: Customers are ordering essentials more often as a result of faster delivery.
taskPhrases.translation: 由于配送更快，客户更频繁地订购日常用品。

more than twice as fast as... 用于比较两个品类的增长速度。
structure.transfer: Faster replenishment helped drive local orders to grow twice as fast as the regional average.

rewrite.good: In its June 24, 2025 announcement, Amazon said it planned to expand Same-Day and Next-Day Delivery to more than 4,000 smaller U.S. communities by the end of 2025. The company said it would invest over $4 billion to triple its delivery network by the end of 2026 and turn some rural stations into hybrid hubs. In areas already served, Amazon reported that more than 90% of its 50 most-repurchased Same-Day Delivery items were everyday essentials.
rewrite.translation: 在 2025 年 6 月 24 日的公告中，Amazon 表示计划在 2025 年底前把同日达和次日达服务扩展到美国 4,000 多个较小社区。公司表示将投入超过 40 亿美元，到 2026 年底把配送网络扩大到三倍，并将部分乡村配送站改造成混合枢纽。在已覆盖地区，Amazon 报告称，同日达复购最多的 50 种商品中，超过 90% 是日常必需品。
rewrite.pattern: [expand the service to new areas] → [by the end of the year] → [as a result of faster delivery]

choice.prompt: 复盘 Amazon 2025 年 6 月公告时，哪句准确区分了截至 2025 年底的扩张计划和截至 2026 年底的网络投资目标？
options: Amazon had already tripled its network and reached every rural community by June 2025.
Amazon planned to reach more than 4,000 smaller communities by the end of 2025 and triple its network by the end of 2026.
Amazon promised to deliver every product within minutes by the end of 2025.
choice.why: 第二句把两个历史公告中的计划和截止时间分开，没有把计划写成已完成，也没有添加送达承诺。
